title: Belarusian — passport practice (ICAO 9303 with Belarusian exceptions)
authority: ICAO Doc 9303 Part 3 §6.B (Belarusian exceptions); MVD practice under Instruction No. 200 of 28.06.2010 (text not retrieved)
description: Spelling observed in Belarusian passports: ICAO Doc 9303 letter-by-letter table with the Belarusian exceptions Г→H, Ё→IO, Ў→U (Й→I, Х→KH, Ц→TS, Ю→IU, Я→IA, Ь and apostrophe omitted), e.g. Марыя Рудзь → Maryia Rudz.
notes: Evidence quality: no primary MVD regulation describing this table was found. The model rests on ICAO Doc 9303 (Г→H, Ё→IO, Ў→U for Belarusian), a 2019 press report ('Maryia Rudz', Г recorded as H, no diacritics under MVD Instruction No. 200 of 2010) and a commercial table (24glo.com). Samples Бабрыковіч Аляксандр, Міховіч Марыя, СВЯТЛАНА, Ігар, МІХАІЛ, Палто Алена, Мікалай are the test vectors of interscript's MVD-2010/ICAO-be maps; the others are computed.

The MFA still cites MVD Instruction No. 288 (be_mvd_288) for passports; a citizen may state a Latin spelling once, and the name may be transliterated from its Russian form instead (use a ru_ scheme for that).
Russian-only letters are included for Russian-form names: И→I, Щ→SHCH, Ъ→IE (ICAO).
